Specification: A script-like TLA+ module that orchestrates model checking runs for the EWD998_opts specification. It iterates over a set of feature flags and node counts, executing TLC as a subprocess via IOEnvExec and logging the results (exit codes and metadata) to a CSV file for performance benchmarking.
AssumptionNames: \A features \in SUBSET Features: \A n \in Nodes: LET ret == IOEnvExec([N |-> n, F |-> features, Out |-> CSVFile], Cmd).exitValue IN CASE ret = 0 -> PrintT(<<JavaTime, n, features>>) [] ret = 10 -> PrintT(<<n, features, "Assumption violation">>) [] ret = 12 -> PrintT(<<n, features, "Safety violation">>) [] ret = 13 -> PrintT(<<n, features, "Liveness violation">>) [] OTHER -> Print(<<n, features, IOEnvExec([N |-> n, F |-> features, Out |-> CSVFile], Cmd), "Error">>, FALSE)
CaseExpr: CASE ret = 0 -> PrintT(<<JavaTime, n, features>>) [] ret = 10 -> PrintT(<<n, features, "Assumption violation">>) [] ret = 12 -> PrintT(<<n, features, "Safety violation">>) [] ret = 13 -> PrintT(<<n, features, "Liveness violation">>) [] OTHER -> Print(..., FALSE) (in ASSUME)
TupleConstructor: <<n, features, IOEnvExec([N |-> n, F |-> features, Out |-> CSVFile], Cmd), "Error">>
DivisionNotes: All four OperatorDefs are non-Boolean ValueDefs: Features and Nodes are sets of strings/integers, CSVFile is a string, Cmd is a sequence of command-line argument strings.

No StatePredicate/TemporalProperty/Init operators because this is a script-style module that only declares constants/operators and uses ASSUME blocks to drive computation; there are no VARIABLE declarations or behavior specifications.
TemporalNesting is false: no temporal operators present.
FunctionConstructors empty; the spec only contains record constructors and tuples.
VerificationTools = [TLC] since this is a TLC-driver script using TLCGet/IOEnvExec/CSVWrite.
